fixed.summary: og check resolves the engine's specifiers (@origingame/engine, /ui, /ui/components, /playtest, /ui-check, bun:test) to what the engine og resolved ships, even when the game's tsconfig maps them itself; the game's other paths stay. A tsconfig from an older template mapped @origingame/engine/ui to the engine's sources, which then type-checked under the game's ES2022 lib (First Light: 42 TS2304s for TextEncoder, atob and DOM types); it now checks clean without an edit.
